metadata.title: Meta Prompt-Guard 86M Independent Empirical Replication
metadata.paper: Purple Llama: Prompt Guard 86M Technical Evaluation (Meta AI, 2024)

paper_reported_results.paper_citation: Meta AI. 'Purple Llama: Open Ecosystem for AI Safety - Prompt Guard 86M Model Card & Technical Report'. In Meta AI Engineering & Research, 2024.

replication_conclusion.summary: Local 3-class empirical replication confirms Meta's published trade-off: strong injection and jailbreak detection (88-90% recall) with a controlled benign FPR (~1.5-2.5%). However, subword/character feature extraction incurs ~7-15ms CPU overhead, confirming that while viable, lightweight pure-linear models are 2-3x faster for Tier 1.
